chunks: It is not permissible for a believer to abandon his believing brother for more than three days.

key_terms.أَخَاهُ الْمُؤْمِنَ: his believing brother; a fellow believer bound by faith
key_terms.الْمُؤْمِنِ: the believer; a person defined by iman (faith)
key_terms.فَوْقَ ثَلَاثٍ: more than three days; the stated limit for estrangement
key_terms.لَا يَحِلُّ: is not permissible; denotes prohibition in context
key_terms.يَهْجُرَ: to abandon or cut off relations

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a believer to shun another believer for more than three days?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that prolonged estrangement between believers is not permissible. It emphasizes preserving brotherhood, reconciliation, and proper conduct within the believing community.
